added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own arm logs, not its prose. baseline_suite and after_suite in manifest.md arm only tests/biot/test_edge_term_tangents.py: FAILED ids are 11 at base and 11 at head, head-only test_tangent_compiles_within_bound[second_residual] against base-only test_tangent_compiles_within_bound[channel_split]. The vertex arms are recorded in test_logs only; comparing gate/base-test_vertex_term_tangents.log and gate/head-test_vertex_term_tangents.log gives the same 5 ids in both arms and adds none. Ten of the eleven edge failures are shared, five of them test_tangent_compiles_within_bound timeouts on compile-bound rows.

goal_fidelity.reason: the confinement half of the goal was measured on H200, titan and CPU and refuted; the node lands as the consolidation, recorded as such in its fragment

findings.text: the gate records only tests/biot/test_edge_term_tangents.py and tests/biot/test_vertex_term_tangents.py at both arms, while the done_when requires 'every test file that imports nova.biot.gradedresidual'; git grep at 82b9f4257 finds tests/biot/test_vertex_edge_tangent_recurrences.py and tests/biot/test_graded_layer_near_corner.py also importing it, and the first exercises _graded_residual_tangent directly, so the file that guards the merged tangent helper was not run at either revision.

the merged quantrant uses cosine = xp.sqrt(1.0 + stretched * stretched) for the panel Jacobian where the deleted _weighted_residual used xp.cosh(stretch); the two are equal mathematically but not bit-identical, and the done_when's clause 'the forward-solve result is bitwise unchanged on CPU x64, or the difference is stated and bounded at 1e-14 relative' has no measurement anywhere in the run (grep over gate/*.log and gate/*.json finds no bitwise, bit-identical or 1e-14 record), so neither limb of that clause is satisfied.

the three test_tangent_matches_base_jvp rows stop at the primal-bit equality assertion (AssertionError: edge_terms: primal bits differ) at both revisions, so the 1e-9 tangent identity is never reached for the edge path the refactor changed; the failure is identical at base cb42f656 and head, so the change adds no failure, but the clause 'the five JVP identities still hold at 1e-9' is not evidenced by any log.

changed_paths lists ten files but the diff against cb42f656 has fifteen: scripts/prototypes/polygon_near_band/confined_arms.py, identity_gate.py, identity_gate.sh, identity_one.sh and weight_mutation.sh are committed and unlisted, so a reader auditing the manifest's own scope record cannot see the scripts that produced the three-device table and the per-row identity runs.

xp.where(near, _weighted_root(self, term), reduced) still evaluates the graded quadrature over the whole target array before the near band is selected, so the confinement the goal names is not delivered; the run records it as refuted by measurement on H200, titan and CPU and reverts the candidate, which is an honest landing, but the plan section's throughput expectation remains unmet.

the deleted _weighted_residual ignored the paired flag its weighted caller passed, while the merged graded_residual now honours paired=paired together with weight=weight and returns a paired structure where a scalar was returned before; no current caller supplies both (polygonanalytic.py:1083 passes paired only, polygonanalytic.py:1481 passes weight only), so the path is latent rather than live, but it is untested and closes a silent behaviour difference without a guard.
